steps.meaning: The realized volume and nature of eligible evidence revise feasibility.
The size and composition of the Review Universe constrain methods (eg, whether meta-analysis is possible).
The emerging Review Universe (eg, known relevant studies missed, off-target records) refines the strategy.
A severe feasibility shortfall can force the team to revisit its purpose.
The strategy is executed against bibliographic sources.
What searching reveals (too much, too little, an unexpected framing) refines the objective and, through it, the question.
The objective is made answerable as a research question.
The agreed purpose in turn shapes what each member seeks from the review.
The team's purpose directs attention to a particular clinical or scientific gap.
